lines.t: Yeshua is my shepherd. I shall not want, I shall not lack. He makes me lie down in green pastures, leads me by still waters, brings me back.
He restores my soul, restores my soul
Guides me in paths of righteousness
For His name's sake, for His holy name
Y'all's who are Hamashiach
My King, my Redeemer
Forever your mercy endures
Your truth ascends high
Holy, holy, holy is your name
Let all the earth sing praise to you
Come out, come out my people
O come, worship in spirit, worship in truth, the Father seeks, such as these, Yahushua is King.
Yahushua HaMashiach
The Holy One of Israel
For He is who He is
And there is none like Him
Says the Lord
Behold I stand at the door
And now hear my voice
Open wide the door
I will come in
Dying with you, you with me
Overcome and sit upon my throne as I overcame
Sat with my Father forever in glory
Forever in light
I am the way, the truth, the life
No one comes to the Father but through me
Return to me with all your heart
I blot out transgressions, remember no more
Yahushua, shepherd of the flock
One flock, one shepherd, forevermore
They shall all be found one flock
Live one shepherd, behold
I shall be their God
And they shall be my people
Oh, forever, says the Lord.
Yahushua, my King, my Redeemer, forever your mercy endures, your truth ascends high.
Holy, holy, holy is your name
Let all the earth sing praise to you
Come out, come out my people
Come, mercy in spirit
Worship in truth
The Father seeks such as these
Yahshua is King
Yahshua is King
Yahshua is King
Heaven
